{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 1.2 Information Gain"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "In this example, we show how to calculate the information gain from the ensemble of model samples generated in Example 1.1, and compare to the information gain under different experimental conditions."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Hello from topophone2!\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#__ Import: Numerical __\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Import: Topophone2 __\n",
    "from topophone2.inversion import MarginalStats\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Import: Plotting __\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import matplotlib.ticker as ticker"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#__ Set up: Plotting __\n",
    "theme = ['#DC4424', '#74A466', '#24448C', '#F8BC5C']\n",
    "small, large = 8, 10\n",
    "plt.rcParams[\"font.sans-serif\"] = ['Arial']\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Disable: Warnings __\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", category=UserWarning)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1.2.1 Read inversion results"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The inversion results in Example 1.1 were stored in the folder ``models/eg1/triad``. Equivalent results for an extra sensor added to the centre of the array were stored in the folder ``models/eg1/extra-receiver``, and for an increased noise level of 10dB in ``models/eg1/extra-noise``."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#__ Load results __\n",
    "inversion_results = dict(\n",
    "    triad = np.load('../models/eg1/triad/inversion_results.npz'),          # Triad geometry, SNR 10dB\n",
    "    noisy = np.load('../models/eg1/extra-noise/inversion_results.npz'),    # Triad geometry, SNR 0dB\n",
    "    quad  = np.load('../models/eg1/extra-receiver/inversion_results.npz')  # Extra sensor, SNR 10dB\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "#    __ `inversion_results` structure __\n",
    "#    Key - Array geometry/noise level,\n",
    "#    Value - dict with structure...\n",
    "#            m :            Model vector            (sample, parameter)\n",
    "#            lnp_dm :       Likelihood              (sample,)\n",
    "#            prior_bounds : Bounds of uniform prior (parameter,)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1.2.2 Calculate information gain"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The ``inversion.MarginalStats`` class is the one-stop shop for posterior analysis. Here, we use the ``calc_information`` method to calculate the information gain for different subsets of parameters under the three different sets of experimental conditions."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#__ Instantiate MarginalStats __\n",
    "marginal_stats = {\n",
    "    key: MarginalStats(**results)\n",
    "    for key, results in inversion_results.items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Calculate information gain: Mean (normal) __\n",
    "idx = [1,2]\n",
    "D_mean = {\n",
    "    key: stats.calc_information(idx=idx)\n",
    "    for key, stats in marginal_stats.items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Calculate information gain: Beamwidth (normal) __\n",
    "idx = [3,4,5]\n",
    "D_bw = {\n",
    "    key: stats.calc_information(idx=idx)\n",
    "    for key, stats in marginal_stats.items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Calculate information gain: Harmonic coefficients __\n",
    "idx = [7,8]\n",
    "D_noise = {\n",
    "    key: stats.calc_information(idx=idx)\n",
    "    for key, stats in marginal_stats.items()\n",
    "}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The signal-to-noise ratio is calculated as the difference in total energies (specified in dB). Posterior analysis can be done on combinations of parameters like this."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#__ Instantiate MarginalStats object for SNR __\n",
    "snr_stats = {\n",
    "    key: MarginalStats(\n",
    "        m = (results['m'][:,0] - results['m'][:,6])[:,None],\n",
    "        lnp_dm       = results['lnp_dm'],\n",
    "        prior_bounds = results['prior_bounds']\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    for key, results in inversion_results.items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate information gain: SNR __\n",
    "idx = [0]\n",
    "D_snr = {\n",
    "    key: stats.calc_information(idx=idx)\n",
    "    for key, stats in snr_stats.items()\n",
    "}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1.2.3 Compare"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We compare the relative change in information gain between the deviated experimental conditions and those in Example 1.1. This gives an indication as to how much tighter (information gain) or broader (information loss) the posterior pdfs were under each set of experimental conditions."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#__ Store as arrays __\n",
    "D_triad = np.array([D_mean['triad'], D_bw['triad'], D_noise['triad'], D_snr['triad']])\n",
    "D_noisy = np.array([D_mean['noisy'],  D_bw['noisy'],  D_noise['noisy'],  D_snr['noisy']])\n",
    "D_quad  = np.array([D_mean['quad'],  D_bw['quad'],  D_noise['quad'],  D_snr['quad']])\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Calculate relative information gain with noise level increased by 10dB __\n",
    "rel_IG_noisy = 100 * (D_noisy - D_triad) / D_triad\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Calculate relative information gain for extra receiver added __\n",
    "rel_IG_quad  = 100 * (D_quad - D_triad) / D_triad"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x200 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#__ Create figure and axes __\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,2), facecolor='white', layout='constrained')\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Format __\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel(\"Information gain [%]\", fontsize=small)\n",
    "ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(20))\n",
    "ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(ticker.MultipleLocator(5))\n",
    "ax.tick_params(labelsize=small)\n",
    "ax.grid(color='gainsboro', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Labels __\n",
    "y      = np.arange(4)[::-1]\n",
    "labels = [r\"$\\mathbf{\\xi}$\", r\"$\\Omega$\", r\"$\\left(a_1, b_1\\right)$\", r\"SNR\"]\n",
    "ax.set_yticks(y, labels)\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Plot information gain __\n",
    "ax.barh(y, rel_IG_quad, color=theme[1], label=\"Extra receiver\", zorder=1)\n",
    "ax.barh(y, rel_IG_noisy, color=theme[2], label=\"Increased noise\", zorder=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Plot neutral __\n",
    "ax.axvline(0, c='k', ls='--', lw=1.0, zorder=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Legend __\n",
    "ax.legend(fontsize=large)\n",
    "\n",
    "#__ Show figure __\n",
    "fig.show()"
   ]
  }
 ],
